title: %center — center-pad to a width
purpose: Pad both sides of a string to center it within a target width.
expectedOutput:
{out}
out = "--hi--"
odd = "--hi---"
wide = "already wide"
spacePad = "  hi  "
notes: Two required arguments plus an optional fill character (default space). When the padding is odd, the extra character goes on the right.
A string already at or above the width is returned unchanged.
